title: Felix and the Kitchen
author: Z. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Elodie Zhou, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
